notes.summary: HCF is the largest number that divides all the given numbers; LCM is the smallest number that all of them divide. Usually 0–1 question, but easy marks.

concepts.title: Finding HCF and LCM
concepts.body: Write each number as a product of primes. HCF = product of common primes with the lowest powers. LCM = product of all primes with the highest powers.

concepts.title: Product rule
concepts.body: For two numbers only: HCF × LCM = first number × second number.

concepts.title: Fractions
concepts.body: HCF of fractions = HCF of numerators / LCM of denominators. LCM of fractions = LCM of numerators / HCF of denominators.

varieties.name: Direct HCF / LCM and product rule
varieties.how: Use prime factors, or HCF × LCM = a × b.

example.q: HCF of two numbers is 6 and LCM is 72. One number is 24. Find the other.

varieties.name: Remainder-based
varieties.how: Same remainder: take HCF of the differences. Same remainder r with all divisors: LCM + r.

example.q: Least number which leaves remainder 3 when divided by 4, 6 and 9?

varieties.name: Bells, lights and tiles
varieties.how: Things happening together again → LCM. Largest equal piece / tile → HCF.

example.q: Three lights blink every 10, 15 and 20 seconds. After how many seconds do they blink together again?

tips: Check options: the LCM must be a multiple of every given number.
traps: HCF × LCM = product works only for two numbers, not three.
For “same remainder” questions, use differences of the numbers, not the numbers themselves.

questions.q: The HCF and LCM of two numbers are 12 and 924 respectively. If one of the numbers is 84, the other number is:
What is the LCM of 12, 18 and 30?
Find the greatest number that divides 1305, 4665 and 6905 leaving the same remainder in each case.
Three bells toll at intervals of 6, 8 and 12 minutes. If they toll together at 9:00 a.m., when will they next toll together?
questions.solution:
They toll together after LCM(6, 8, 12) minutes.
LCM = 24 minutes.
9:00 a.m. + 24 min = 9:24 a.m.

questions.q: What is the least number which, when divided by 12, 15, 20 and 54, leaves a remainder of 8 in each case?
What is the HCF of 2/3, 8/9 and 16/81?
questions.solution:
HCF of fractions = HCF of numerators / LCM of denominators.
HCF(2, 8, 16) = 2; LCM(3, 9, 81) = 81.
HCF = 2/81.
